🏡 Housing Options & Housing Fraud
What options are available as your needs change, and what are some of the common scams targeting homeowners and seniors? We’ll talk about what to watch for and how you can better protect yourself.

🏠 Reverse Mortgages & Aging in Place
Portia Vigil will explain how today’s reverse mortgage products work and how they can potentially help homeowners use the equity they’ve built in their homes to age in place, rather than feeling that assisted living is their only option when their needs change.

💙 Medicare
Sharee Atchison will help explain Medicare and the important choices seniors and their families need to understand.

📜 Wills & Trusts
Charles Kline will discuss wills, trusts, and why having a plan in place can help protect the people and assets that matter most to you.

This isn’t about telling you what you should do. It’s about giving you information, answering your questions, and helping you understand your options so you can make decisions that are right for you and your family.

📍 North Fork Senior Center | Paonia
📅 Thursday, September 24
⏰ 3–4 PM
📞 970-596-1816

Come join us, bring your questions, and bring someone you love. You may walk away with an answer to a question you didn’t even know you needed to ask. 💙

Seeing a handler without their service dog doesn’t mean they suddenly stopped being disabled. 💚

There are so many reasons a handler may choose—or need—to leave their service dog at home.

Maybe their needs fluctuate from day to day. Maybe they have another form of support available. Maybe the environment isn’t appropriate or safe for their dog. Or maybe their service dog simply needs a well-deserved day off. 🐕‍🦺

A service dog is a tool that helps mitigate a disability, but having a disability doesn’t mean a handler must have their dog beside them every second of every day.

You’re seeing one moment, not the whole story.

No service dog ≠ no disability. 🦮🐾💚

Let’s normalize trusting disabled people to know what support they need—and when they need it.
